g.text: playbook.py selects play from possession, game phase, ball zone
each play defines roles needed + what each role accomplishes
role_assignments.py auctions roles via cost functions
each tactic is an FSM that transitions on local conditions
reusable primitives, output target positions, no game knowledge

svg.text: Execution trace — one frame of a real game
Ball at midfield, our team just gained possession

g.text: builds GameState: ball (4.5, 3.0), robot 0 closest, clear shot = false
we have possession → offensive play: 1 attacker + 1 supporter + 1 defender
role_assignments.py: robot 0 → attacker, robot 1 → supporter, robot 2 → defender

svg.text: Next frame: attacker near supporter → switches to "pass"
→ kick.py aimed at supporter → supporter calls navigate.py with ball vel
